page: Microsoft Azure DC32eds_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor and features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-speed local disk access. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The inclusion of a dedicated 1890 GB NVMe SSD local storage drive makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring fast temporary storage and low-latency disk access. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC32eds_v6 provides a balanced allocation of dedicated compute cores and memory alongside substantial local NVMe capacity, positioning it as a solid option for resource-dense deployments without the overhead of GPU hardware. This server type is suited for database hosting, enterprise applications, local data processing, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and fast local storage.
